summary: Ansible 9 flagged community.azure, hpe.nimble, netapp.azure, netapp.elementsw and netapp.um_info as unmaintained for removal from Ansible 10, and noted community.sap was renamed to community.sap_libs.
questions: Will netapp.elementsw stay in the Ansible package?
What's the new name for community.sap?

answer_card.title: Collections slated for removal in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md:
Unmaintained, removed from **Ansible 10** unless maintained again: **community.azure, hpe.nimble, netapp.azure, netapp.elementsw, netapp.um_info**. Install them manually if needed.

**community.sap** was renamed to **community.sap_libs**; update your FQCNs.
